paper.title_en: Towards a Carrollian Description of Yang-Mills
paper.abstract_en: We provide a theory defined purely on null infinity that describes Yang-Mills in the Minkowski space bulk. The dynamical field of our model is the characteristic data of the bulk gauge field, and the action combines an electric branch Carrollian kinetic term with non-local interactions of MHV type that link different points on the celestial sphere. We explicitly show how this theory recovers all MHV and NMHV tree amplitudes in Yang-Mills, and outline how arbitrary tree amplitudes may be obtained from its Feynman diagram expansion. The detailed expression we find for the NMHV amplitude appears to be new.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在零无穷（null infinity）上构建纯边界理论以描述体内部Yang-Mills场，把Carrollian动力学与MHV型非局域相互作用结合，并声称可从费曼图展开恢复全部树级振幅、且给出看似新的NMHV振幅表达式。与广义相对论基础中边界/渐近结构主题高度相关，理论深度较高，值得点击阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们给出了一个纯粹定义在零无穷上的理论，它描述Minkowski空间体内部的Yang-Mills理论。我们模型的动力学场是体规范场的特征数据，其作用量将一个电分支的Carrollian动能项与MHV型、连接天球上不同点的非局域相互作用结合起来。我们明确展示该理论如何恢复Yang-Mills中所有MHV与NMHV树级振幅，并概述如何通过其费曼图展开得到任意树级振幅。我们所得的NMHV振幅详细表达式似乎是新的。
